name: Hagane no Oni ~Kidou Hohei vs Onna Ninja Gundan~
original_name: 鋼の鬼 ～機動歩兵VS女忍者軍団～
source:
A monarch died in a certain country of the Far East, and the young heir "Kikuyo Chiyo" took the seat. However, his uncle drafted a female ninja corps to assassinate Kikuyo. The Freedom Association dispatched a special robotic unit secretly to prevent the assassination. Over 50 ninja attacked the cemetery where assassination was decided, but Kikuyo was a decoy and a huge metal robot appeared before their sight instead. How will latest robotic unit fight against female ninja corps that make use of numerous secret techniques?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
遙遠東亞某國的一位君主去世後，年輕繼承人菊代千代登上王位。然而，他的叔叔組建了一支女忍者部隊，企圖刺殺千代。自由協會為阻止這場暗殺，暗中派出了一支特種機器人部隊。五十多名忍者襲擊了約定進行暗殺的墓地，可千代只是誘餌，真正出現在她們面前的，竟是一臺巨大的金屬機器人。最新型機器人部隊將如何與施展無數秘術的女忍者軍團交戰？
